components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for send, confirm, and primary interactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f8ef7; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f8ef7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — transparent with border, accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #7a7f88; border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #4f8ef7; color: #d1d2d3; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input with carbon background and border focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1a1d21; color: #d1d2d3; border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a7f88; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4f8ef7; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Card / Container
components.description: Surface container for modals, panels, and elevated content.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #222529; border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; color: #d1d2d3; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Channel or DM item in the sidebar with hover and active states.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 16px; border: none; background: none; color: #7a7f88; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #2d3035; color: #d1d2d3; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(79,142,247,0.15); color: #d1d2d3; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Unread Badge
components.description: Accent pill showing unread message count.
components.css: .ds-badge { background: #4f8ef7; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 4px; }

components.name: Reaction Chip
components.description: Emoji reaction toggle with own-state highlight.
components.css: .ds-reaction { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s, border-color 0.1s; } .ds-reaction:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-reaction--mine { background: rgba(79,142,247,0.15); border-color: #4f8ef7; }

components.name: Presence Dot
components.description: Status indicator circle — color-coded by user presence.
components.css: .ds-presence { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Role Badge
components.css: .ds-role-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 6px; color: #7a7f88; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

components.name: Modal Overlay
components.description: Full-screen backdrop with centered content panel.
components.css: .ds-modal-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 100; } .ds-modal { background: #222529; border: 1px solid #2d3035; border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; width: min(480px, 100%); box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); color: #d1d2d3; }

narrative.overview:
PinGGo's visual language is a calm, dark command center — an interface that recedes into the background so conversations take center stage. The palette is deliberately restrained: deep carbon surfaces, muted borders, and a single blue accent that appears only where action is needed. Every element earns its presence through function, not decoration.

The system follows a minimal-and-functional philosophy: "Design that doesn't get in the way, just works." Typography is the system font stack — invisible by design, optimized for readability at chat density. Depth is conveyed through subtle tonal layering rather than shadows, with elevation reserved exclusively for interactive states and modal overlays.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent blue for all interactive states
Tonal layering over shadows for depth

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The accent blue is reserved for elements the user can act on. Never use it for decorative purposes or passive content. Its visual weight comes from restraint.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated through background color progression (bg → surface → border), not through drop shadows. Shadows appear only as a response to elevation state.

rules.name: The Readability Density Rule
rules.body: At chat density, every pixel of line-height matters. Body text never drops below 1.5 line-height; captions never below 1.3. Readability outranks compactness.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and elevation effects only appear as a direct response to user interaction (hover, focus) or system state (modal open).

dos: Do use the accent blue sparingly — only for interactive elements and active states
Do maintain the tonal hierarchy: bg → surface → border for depth
Do use system fonts for all text — no external font imports
Do keep message density high with tight vertical gaps (3–5px)
Do use functional colors consistently: green=online, yellow=away, red=dnd
donts: Don't use accent blue for decorative elements or passive content
Don't add drop shadows to flat elements at rest
Don't use sharp corners (0px radius) on interactive elements
Don't mix multiple accent colors — the single blue is the only action color
Don't reduce body line-height below 1.5 — readability at chat density is critical
